notes.title: Mountains of Madness is available now!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Those who added the game to your wishlist will surely have noticed, but we’re going to share it with you one more time just in case: [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/962700/Chronicle_of_Innsmouth_Mountains_of_Madness/]Chronicle of Innsmouth: Mountains of Madness[/url], the sequel to this game, is now available for purchase on Steam![/b]

This journey has been a long but exciting one, and[b] the whole team of Psychodev wants to thank you sincerely for all the support[/b] you’ve been giving us since we launched the Kickstarter campaign in October 2018. Now it’s time to face a new mystery [b]that will test your investigation skills[/b] − and sanity, for no mind can stand the sight of the cosmic horrors that lurk in the shadows... 

If  you want to help us, you can spread the word about the game, and[b] leave us your honest review here on Steam. [/b]We will be paying attention to the Steam forums, so[b] don't hesitate to ask any questions, send us your suggestions [/b]− or just inform us if you experience any technical issues. [b]Take a look at Mountains of Madness... if you dare!
[/b]

notes.title: The Kickstarter campaign for Chronicle of Innsmouth: Mountains of Madness is live!
notes.notes:
Hi friends,

it's with great pleasure that we can announce to have launched the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/201868287/chronicle-of-innsmouth-mountains-of-madness]Kickstarter campaign[/url] for the next game of the saga: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/962700/Chronicle_of_Innsmouth_Mountains_of_Madness/]Mountains of Madness[/url]. We'd be delighted if you can check it out and give us your feedback.

There's also an alpha-demo available, so you can check for yourselves the improvement we made in the graphics and storytelling aspects.

Thanks a lot for your support!
